decision.finding: The pinned P0 final-state regression uses different as_of_ms; a same-clock mixed generation can pass its stamp-equality oracle. Exact runner.py writes latest/audit/handoff independently, and its source-error markers are present in all three artifacts: compact.audit_flags includes SOURCE_COLLECTION_ERRORS_PRESENT; audit.source_errors is nonempty; handoff.availability.source_errors_present is true. This yields a deterministic same-clock generation sentinel without fabricating observations or touching protected consumers. Source-derived expected failure only; NOT EXECUTED.
improved_runnable_test_contract: In a disposable exact-SHA checkout, test-only add a parametrized case to part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py. Use shared tmp_path and identical as_of_ms=1800000000000 for both writer A and writer B; network=False and no Kote/Glassnode.

Writer A calls runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=T) and must return source_errors=[]. Writer B calls runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path, external_jsonl=(tmp_path/'deliberately_missing.jsonl',), as_of_ms=T); assert B returns a nonempty source_errors list (JsonlFlowAdapter missing-file error) without raising. This makes B distinguishable with zero market/network fixtures.

Reuse corrected pinned P0 gate on runner.atomic_write_json: A pauses after its latest.json replacement, B starts; if B reaches latest.json before A release, require B completes; if B is serialized behind A, release A before waiting for B completion. Always release in finally, bounded joins and no surviving threads.

After both return, load all three JSON files; require identical as_of_ms AND semantic coherence: ('SOURCE_COLLECTION_ERRORS_PRESENT' in latest.audit_flags) == bool(audit.source_errors) == bool(handoff.availability.source_errors_present). The current unguarded order predicts [True,False,False] with equal timestamps; this is an expected RED, not a measured result. Also assert no archive observations.jsonl and both writer calls completed.

Preserve independent reader interleave and P1 POSIX process tests as separate gates; this test proves only final same-clock writer coherence. For GREEN require non-skipped target and full Capital Flow suite; preserve stdout/stderr, exit codes, exact SHA and overlay hash.
